models.name: MINI 20
models.firmware_note: NiCd cells; BEC 3 servos up to 8 cells, 2 servos at 10 cells; brushed (2 motor wires)
models.spec_source: Kontronik_Mini20.pdf p.1: 6-14 V (6-10 NiCd cells), 20 A continuous

automatable_note: A jumper must be fitted on the gold contacts before power-up and pulled in the middle of phase 2; power is disconnected and reconnected. The bench cannot place the jumper.

manual.action: Fit the jumper on the two gold contacts; it stays on through phase 1.
Between phases: power off, pull the jumper, power on. Phase 2: pull it between the flashes to switch cutoff off.

entry.confirm_signal: LED flash with a beep if the motor is connected after power-up.
steps: Operator: fit the jumper on the gold contacts. Radio on.
Phase 1: throttle to brake (off) stop, connect drive power; flash and beep.
Move to full throttle; flash. Move to neutral; two flashes.
Reconnect drive power without the jumper.
Phase 2 (optional): throttle at full, connect power; flash then three flashes; pull the jumper if cutoff should be off; three flashes confirm.
Reconnect drive power without the jumper.

announce.description: Signals are LED flashes with a beep when the motor is connected.

select.description: Throttle moved to each requested position after each flash.

skip.description: Not applicable: the sequence has no menu; every step is taught in order.

scheme.confirm_signal: Two flashes after phase 1; three flashes after phase 2.
scheme.exit: Disconnect power, reconnect without the jumper.
scheme.description: Phase 1 teaches brake, full and neutral positions and whether the short-circuit brake is used. Phase 2 sets undervoltage cutoff (0.8 V per cell) on or off by the jumper state at the final three flashes.

values.name: neutral equals full: no brake; brake stop equals off
neutral and brake position equal: motor-off equals brake
on (0.8 V per cell): jumper still fitted
